evidence_dispersion.rationale: Legacy file/hop compatibility classification; v0.3 obligations all have explicit local recovery evidence and E0.

contract_opacity.rationale: The README exposes product behavior but omits the executable visit, supersession, breadcrumb, and synchronous reentry relations; those relations must be composed from local source evidence.

temporal_composition.rationale: Eight atomic predicates; body/outline/history newest-visit consistency is one obligation, not three.

schedule_complexity.rationale: Fourteen schedules distinguish quiet saves, ordinary navigation, nested navigation and preview behavior.

consumer_heterogeneity.rationale: Two real lifecycle policies: persistent draft flush versus transient preview discard.

repair_locus_ambiguity.rationale: Editor lifecycle, outer workspace projection, and shared batch semantics are three plausible loci.

framework_execution_complexity.rationale: Native ESM callbacks and injected timers; no framework lifecycle emulation.

structured_judgment.rationale: Legacy compatibility tier; see v0.3 execution coverage rather than interpreting this as measured model difficulty.
